items.alt: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra turns a repo-rate valve from 5.25% to 5.50%, sending rupee notes toward a home as an EMI gauge rises.
Novak Djokovic stands in a Beijing trophy room beside seven trophies and a 34–0 sign while de Minaur's abandoned gear sits outside.
Lionel Messi looks back toward a packed Argentina stadium during his farewell, with a 3–0 scoreboard, 126 goals and 208 caps behind him.
Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi sit beside a trespass FIR while a Supreme Court judge examines a CEC appointment-law recall plea.
